PREFIX brick: <http://brick.schema.org/>
PREFIX ref: <http://w3.org/ns/leap/REOntology#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999-02-22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?s ?p ?o WHERE { ?s ?p ?o } LIMIT 50

PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?zone ?label ?point ?ptype ?tsid WHERE {
  ?zone a brick:Zone .
  OPTIONAL { ?zone rdfs:label ?label }
  ?zone brick:hasPoint ?point .
  ?point a ?ptype .
  ?point ref:hasExternalReference ?tsref .
  ?tsref ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
}

PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?z ?lbl WHERE { ?z rdfs:label ?lbl . FILTER(CONTAINS(STR(?z),"Zone_F2")) }

PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?z ?lbl WHERE { ?z rdfs:label ?lbl . FILTER(CONTAINS(STR(?lbl),"Core")) }
